favors.line: But I've done the law some favors
stanza: Things I cannot tell a soul
Like the children that I've orphaned
And the fortune that I stole
Till he washed up on the shoal
But I've done the law some favors

favors.line: There was nobody calling me up for favors
stanza: I was a free man in Paris, I felt unfettered and alive
There was nobody calling me up for favors
And no one's future to decide
You know I'd go back there tomorrow
But for the work I've taken on
Stoking the star maker machinery behind the popular song
